privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data LifePlan (budget.luisvespa.com) processes, what it is used for and who it is shared with. LifePlan is a free app, in beta, for organising your budget and your debts.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: The controller of your data is Luis Vespa. For any privacy question, write to contact@luisvespa.com.

sections.title: What data we process
paragraphs: We only process the data you enter in the app or that is generated by using it:
items: Your account: name, email and password. For the password we store only a hash (bcrypt), never the password itself. If you sign in with Google, we store the name, email and profile picture address that Google provides.
One-time verification codes we email you to confirm your account or reset your password. They expire after 15 minutes.

Your financial data: income, expenses (amount, date, description and category), budget and categories, accounts and balances, cards, loans, installment plans and debts with their payments, savings goals, rules for categorising expenses and your preferences (language, theme, payday).
Bank statements you import: when you upload a CSV or Excel file, the server reads it to extract the transactions. We store the transactions you confirm (date, amount and description), not the file.

Your household: if you invite someone to share finances, we store their email and the invitation, and send them an email with the link. People in the same household see the shared data according to the household's privacy level.
Technical data: the logs the server produces while running (for example, errors), which include data such as the request's IP address.

sections.title: What LifePlan does not do
paragraphs: LifePlan does not connect to your bank today: data only gets in because you type it or import a file. It does not move money or make payments. It shows no ads, does not sell your data or hand it to third parties for their own purposes, and uses no analytics or advertising cookies. Nor does it make automated decisions that legally affect you.

sections.title: What we use it for, and on what basis
paragraphs: We use your data to provide the service you ask for when you sign up: storing your information, calculating your budget, your committed future and your debt payoff plan, and sending you the necessary emails (verification, password reset, welcome and household invitations). The legal basis is the performance of the contract you accept when creating your account (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Technical logs are used to keep the service running and secure, on the basis of legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.title: Artificial intelligence classification
paragraphs: When you import a statement, the app may offer buttons to classify expenses or suggest categories with AI. Only if you press one of those buttons do we send Anthropic (the provider of the Claude model) the uncategorised merchant descriptions from that statement, up to 40 at a time, and, to classify them, the names of your budget categories.

We do not send amounts, dates, your name, your email or account numbers. Bear in mind that the description is the text your bank writes and sometimes includes other data, such as the name of the person you sent a transfer to. What the AI returns are only suggestions, which you review before anything is saved.

sections.title: Providers that process data on our behalf
paragraphs: To run LifePlan we use these providers, which process data only to provide their service to us:
items: Neon: the PostgreSQL database where your data is stored, hosted in the European Union (Frankfurt).
Vercel: hosting for the website and the app's server, which runs in Frankfurt.
Resend: sending the app's emails (your email address and the message content).
Google: sign-in with Google, only if you choose to use it. The website also loads its fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser sends your IP address to Google when you open it.
Anthropic: the AI classification described above, only when you ask for it.
sections.after: Some of these providers are US companies and may process data outside the European Economic Area. They do so with the safeguards set out in their data processing terms, such as the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

sections.title: Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: LifePlan uses a single cookie, called "token", which keeps you signed in. It is technical and strictly necessary: it cannot be read by JavaScript, it expires after 7 days and it is deleted when you sign out. Your browser also keeps in its local storage the language you choose and whether you have hidden the "Finish your setup" notice. We use no analytics, advertising or third-party cookies, which is why we don't ask for your consent to them.

sections.title: How long we keep data
paragraphs: We keep your data while you have an account. You can delete the transactions, accounts, debts and other items you created at any time from within the app. Verification codes expire after 15 minutes and household invitations after 7 days.

The app does not yet have a button to delete your account. To do so, write to contact@luisvespa.com from your account's email address and we will delete it together with all its data. The database provider's backups may keep it for a limited period before it is erased.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: All communication is encrypted over HTTPS, passwords are stored hashed, the session cookie cannot be read by JavaScript and every request for your data requires a signed-in session. No system is completely secure: if we detect a problem affecting your data, we will inform you as the law requires.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to access, correct or erase your data, object to or restrict its processing, and ask for a copy in a commonly used format (portability). Write to contact@luisvespa.com and we will reply within one month. If you believe we have not handled your data properly, you can complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).

sections.title: Minors
paragraphs: LifePlan is intended for people aged 18 or over. You must not create an account if you are under 18.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we will update this page and its date. If the change is significant, we will let you know before it applies.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of LifePlan (budget.luisvespa.com), an app by Luis Vespa for organising your budget and your debts. By creating an account or using the app, you accept them.

sections.title: A free beta
paragraphs: LifePlan is in beta and is free. During the beta, features may change, be added or be removed. If there are ever paid plans, we will announce them in advance and will never charge you anything without your explicit agreement.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: To use LifePlan you must be at least 18 and give accurate details when signing up. You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for what is done with your account. If you think someone has accessed it, write to contact@luisvespa.com.

sections.title: Not financial advice
paragraphs: LifePlan is a tool to help you get organised. Its figures (budget, committed future, debt-free date, payoff order) are estimates calculated from the data you enter, and are only as accurate as that data. They are not financial, legal or tax advice. LifePlan is not a bank, does not move money or make payments for you, and decisions about your money are always yours.

sections.title: Acceptable use
paragraphs: You agree to use LifePlan lawfully and, in particular, not to:
items: try to access other people's accounts or data;
attack, overload or try to bypass the service's security, or use it in an abusive automated way;
upload files with malicious content or data you have no right to use;
invite someone to your household without their consent.

sections.title: Your data and your household
paragraphs: The data you enter remains yours. How we process it is explained in the Privacy policy. If you share your finances with someone through a household, they will see the shared data according to the household's privacy level; choose carefully what you share.

sections.title: No warranty
paragraphs: LifePlan is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind. As a beta, it may have bugs, interruptions or, in exceptional cases, data loss: keep your own records of anything important. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from using the app or from decisions made based on its figures. Nothing here limits your rights under consumer protection law or liability for wilful misconduct or gross negligence.

sections.title: Ending the service or your account
paragraphs: You can stop using LifePlan whenever you want and ask us to delete your account by writing to contact@luisvespa.com. We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms. We may also end the beta or the service; in that case we will give you reasonable notice whenever possible.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: If we change these terms, we will update this page and its date. If the change is significant, we will let you know before it applies; if you disagree, you can stop using the service.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, any dispute will be settled by the courts of your place of residence.

paragraphs: For any question about these terms, write to contact@luisvespa.com.
